Siofra galloped into Empires & Puzzles back in mid-2024 as part of the Clash of Knights event, representing the regal
Ice Legendary hero, she was designed to be a blitzkrieg attacker—hitting hard, hitting fast, and making sure the enemy team regrets bringing a healer.

While the "Clash of Knights" event often feels like a medieval fever dream (Bears vs. Stags vs. Wolves vs. Ravens?), Siofra stands out with her elegant yet deadly kit. She’s a pure offensive tempo controller, stripping the enemy of their offensive power and their ability to recover.

Siofra sports a high-fantasy aesthetic that screams "Don't mess with the forest." She dons ornate golden armor with a prominent stag motif, including a helmet that essentially gives her a second set of antlers. The blue cape flows dramatically, signaling her Ice element. It’s a regal, commanding look—she looks less like a soldier and more like the queen of the hunt who just spotted you stepping on a twig.

If you pulled Siofra, celebrate! She is an incredible asset for map stages and early raiding. Her speed will teach you the value of "ghosting" tiles to charge in 6 moves. Prioritize her leveling immediately.

She is a "luxury" depth hero for War attacks. She doesn't make the cut for the primary Defense team anymore, and she might struggle in top-tier PVP against the newest 1500+ Power monsters. However, she is arguably one of the best counters to "stall" defenses that rely on heavy healing. Don't Limit Break her a second time unless you specifically lack fast Blue damage.
